resharper_disable_blank_line_changes #

Every run of blank lines survives exactly as written: no cap truncates one, no requirement inserts one, no removal near a brace deletes one. Line breaks that are not blank lines still move. Implemented; Tier D until the key-flip sweep reaches it. SK-DIV-0060.

resharper_disable_int_align #

A master switch over a family the export has already switched off, so inert alone and decisive one key away: with int_align = true supplied alongside it turns the whole family off again. Re-measured; the recorded probe holds. SK-DIV-0060. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable by a one-key flip. The recorded probe holds and is now separated from the sweep's reach. Alone, at the export's resharper_int_align = false, both engines are flat — a one-key oracle glob would report UNEXERCISED. With resharper_int_align = true supplied alongside, both engines distinguish the values and disagree at false, on a fixture whose baseline already disagrees. It is the pairwise pass's key, not the key-flip sweep's. SK-DIV-0060.

resharper_disable_space_changes_before_trailing_comment #

Unreachable rather than unimplemented: the one rule it could gate is space_before_trailing_comment, and the oracle normalises the gap identically at both of that key's values with this one on. Its broad sibling disable_space_changes does preserve the same gap, so the narrow key is the one the C# formatter does not consult. SK-DIV-0060. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable / inert. Confirmed at both values under three configurations: resharper_csharp_space_before_trailing_comment true, the same false, and the broad sibling resharper_disable_space_changes = true. Flat in both engines every time, on a fixture carrying a wide gap before a trailing comment.

resharper_ignore_space_preservation #

Inert on every shape and every pairing tried, including the three places the C# formatter demonstrably does preserve spaces — a disabled #if branch, an @formatter:off region and an int-aligned run. The confirmation the sweep could not give, because a one-key flip cannot rule out a mask. SK-DIV-0060. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified unreachable / inert. Confirmed. Flat at both values on an @formatter:off region beside a disabled #if branch, and again on an extra-spaces fixture held at resharper_csharp_extra_spaces = leave_all — the configuration under which the oracle does preserve spaces, and therefore the one where a suppression switch would show. SK-DIV-0060.
